title: NASA employee wrote a CIA remote viewing training manual

tellings.quote: one of the people at NASA wrote a CIA training manual for remote viewing.

plain: Someone at NASA wrote a training manual for the CIA on remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant or hidden places with the mind alone. This comes from Kevin Knuth, a former NASA scientist, who tells Michels in a single line what someone else told him, without saying who wrote it or when. If true, it would tie people at the space agency to the CIA's interest in psychic spying.
